architecture_principles: a discovered material regularity is only usable inside the chemistry family in which it was measured
a scientific applicability boundary is executable code, not prompt advice
the language model may criticize the rule and may not override it
value of information is computed by a deterministic tool over the admissible set only
held-out result data are structurally removed before any payload is assembled
every gate decision carries a machine-readable reason and is serialized with the run

arm_difference_declaration.forbidden_confound: Hiding applicability information from V5_NO_GATE while showing it to V5_FULL is prohibited by protocol v1.1.
held_identical: model endpoint and stage model assignment
evidence access profile and filtered evidence state
raw assess_shared_shape_applicability outputs for every candidate
the full inadmissible-card list and its machine-readable reasons
VOI implementation, weights and tie epsilon
arm_difference_declaration.information_parity_evidence: build_pre_enforcement_payload() takes no arm argument, and its SHA-256 is written into every run as pre_enforcement_payload_sha256. The two arms must report the same hash.
arm_difference_declaration.only_intended_difference: whether the identical chemistry-domain applicability audit is enforced as hard experiment-card admissibility before VOI and at freeze
arm_difference_declaration.payload_consequence: Both arms receive the same audit, the same per-candidate applicability outputs and the same inadmissible-card list. V5_NO_GATE marks the audit advisory and keeps every card selectable; V5_FULL marks it binding and removes the inadmissible cards from the ranked set.

candidate_space.rationale: V5 reuses the byte-identical V3/V4 lattice so that the measured change is the chemistry-domain constraint, not the search space.

architecture.canonical_flow: planner(intent + failure mode) -> mandatory chemistry-audited local science tool -> deterministic chemistry-domain applicability audit (identical and model-visible in both arms) -> enforcement (V5_FULL only) -> VOI over the selectable set -> proposer -> skeptic -> robustness adjudicator -> judge -> freeze

rules: M-HOLD-120 is admissible: it measures thermal-hold drift directly and does not use the shared thermal-response shape.
M-REPEAT is admissible: it measures realization/state spread directly.
M-SWEEP is admissible: it is the direct verification measurement for a chemistry-shifted candidate.

M-ANCHOR is admissible only when assess_shared_shape_applicability returns shared_shape_use equal to allowed_with_state_anchor, or when configs/verified_shape_transfer.json records a completed direct sweep for the same chemistry family.
Otherwise M-ANCHOR is inadmissible_before_shape_verification. This is deterministic inadmissibility, not a VOI penalty and not prompt advice.

architecture.claim_boundary: V5.0.0 selects an experiment from pre-result evidence under an outcome-blind runtime with a deterministic chemistry-domain admissibility constraint. A V5 result is evidence about executable scientific constraints on measurement choice. It is not a wet-lab result and does not claim that the historical decision used this ranking.
architecture.manuscript_boundary: V5 run results must not be written into manuscript/MAIN_TEXT_V5.md or manuscript/SUPPLEMENTARY_INFORMATION_V5.md until the run series is audited and explicitly frozen by the author.
architecture.name: PUR_NEW_CHEMISTRY_GATED_EXPERIMENT_SELECTION_AGENT_V5
non_goals: adding a language model to compute value of information or admissibility
adding Agent roles beyond planner, tools, proposer, skeptic, robustness adjudicator, judge and freeze
re-running, rewriting or reinterpreting the frozen V4 series

primary_arms.role: advice-only control isolating the incremental effect of turning identical scientific applicability information into an executable hard constraint
prospective chemistry-aware Agent V5 with executable scientific constraints

architecture.purpose: Test whether an experimentally discovered material regularity and its chemistry-domain boundary can be executed as a hard scientific constraint on which measurement an outcome-blind Agent is allowed to select.

stages.role: identify the physical failure mode and the scientific question the next experiment must answer, and request the evidence needed to judge experiments rather than formulations
execute read-only scientific tools. The chemistry-audited local rheology summary is mandatory and is forced into the trace whether or not the planner requested it.

deterministic, non-LLM measurement-applicability audit. Computed once per run without reference to the arm, fully visible to the model in both arms, serialized in full, and never produced by a model stage.
V5_FULL only. Converts the identical audit into hard admissibility before VOI ranking and again at freeze. It cannot be overridden by any model stage.
propose the experiment with the highest scientific information value from the cards present in the payload
attack the proposed experiment on hypothesis coverage, confounding, interpretability and whether its falsification criterion can actually be met
adjudicate whether the proposed experiment survives the reported weight sensitivity and the strongest objection
commit to one experiment card present in the payload, or abstain, and state its acceptance and falsification criteria
programmatically validate and freeze the experiment card. A selection outside the admissible set is rejected at freeze rather than repaired.

architecture.supersedes_nothing: V5 is a new prospective runtime. configs/agent_v4.json, scripts/run_agent_v4.py, prompts/agent_v4_*.txt, src/pur_new/voi.py and every frozen V3/V4 run record remain unchanged and are not reinterpreted by V5.

voi_tool.explicitly_not: distance to any held-out formulation. No target coordinate enters any component, weight or tie-break.
voi_tool.formula: VOI = w_hyp * hypothesis_discrimination + w_unc * uncertainty_reduction + w_dec * decision_relevance + w_int * measurement_interpretability - w_ext * extrapolation_risk - w_proc * process_state_risk
voi_tool.name: score_experiment_cards

decision_stability_sent_to_model.evaluated_over: the selectable experiment cards of this arm
decision_stability_sent_to_model.metric_is_not: model confidence; posterior probability; calibrated expected information
decision_stability_sent_to_model.voi_formula: VOI = w_hyp * hypothesis_discrimination + w_unc * uncertainty_reduction + w_dec * decision_relevance + w_int * measurement_interpretability - w_ext * extrapolation_risk - w_proc * process_state_risk. Every component is normalized to [0, 1] by construction. This is a transparent normalized score with reported weight sensitivity, not a Bayesian posterior.

evidence_policy.description: For prospective/blind Agent evaluation. The Agent may see original-system measurements and external analogue evidence, but not the target validation formulation identity, its wet-lab outcome, or any outcome-derived labels.

judge_normalized.acceptance_criterion: Using at least three independently prepared candidate samples and matched independently prepared unmodified references, accept exactly one level hypothesis only if the mean matched 120-130 C viscosity-level change and its two-sided 95% confidence interval are wholly contained within that hypothesis's 3.40 percentage-point prediction band: H-LEVEL-DILUTE, -54.69% to -47.89% around -51.29%; H-LEVEL-ASSOC, 25.31% to 32.11% around 28.71%; or H-LEVEL-PLASTIC, -92.19% to -85.39% around -88.79%.
judge_normalized.chemistry_support_statement: The primary viscosity levels are measured directly within the 80-130 C temperature support for the selected resin-modified AC1920/TK100 chemistry, so they do not depend on transferring the unmodified-family shared thermal shape. The primary observable therefore stays inside direct measurement support, but the chemistry is outside the previously measured unmodified rheological regularity family. E_eta is a fitted rheological descriptor for this sweep and does not establish transfer of the prior shared shape or a molecular mechanism.
judge_normalized.falsification_criterion: Falsify H-LEVEL-DILUTE if the two-sided 95% confidence interval for the mean level change excludes -51.29% by more than 3.40 percentage points; falsify H-LEVEL-ASSOC if the interval excludes 28.71% by more than 3.40 percentage points; falsify H-LEVEL-PLASTIC if the interval excludes -88.79% by more than 3.40 percentage points. A confidence interval overlapping none of the three bands falsifies all three registered level hypotheses for this aggregate composition; an interval wider than the relevant band is inconclusive rather than falsifying.
judge_normalized.next_experiment_if_falsified: Run direct 80-130 C M-SWEEP measurements on independently prepared single-axis acrylic-only and minor-tackifier-only formulations, each with matched unmodified references and at least three repeats, to resolve the aggregate AC1920/TK100 response into axis-specific formulation-level effects.
judge_normalized.primary_observable: Directly measured realized viscosity level at 120 and 130 C, expressed as the percent change relative to a matched unmodified reactive-core reference, from an 80-130 C sweep in 10 C increments; the sweep also reports the fitted rheological descriptor E_eta.
judge_normalized.rationale: S1C51::M-SWEEP is admissible under the binding chemistry audit and directly measures the decision quantity in the new resin-modified chemistry. It has the highest deterministic VOI family and separates the three registered formulation-level level predictions in principle, while the direct sweep avoids unaudited shared-shape transfer. The result cannot attribute effects independently to AC1920 and TK100 or establish molecular association or plasticization; those claims remain outside the rheological evidence.
judge_normalized.stage_disagreements_resolved: I followed the Robustness Adjudicator and Skeptic over the Proposer on interpretation and replication: I retained the proposed candidate and direct M-SWEEP, but replaced the single-repeat 3.40% decision with at least three independent preparations, matched references, and confidence-interval-based criteria because the documented realization-state spread makes a single-repeat 3.40% falsification unattainable. I followed the deterministic ranking only for the admissible top set and broke its genuine tie in favor of the centrally supported 20% acrylic-like and 5% minor-tackifier-like composition.

planner.chemistry_support_statement: The local rheological regularities were measured in the original reactive polyurethane hot-melt local chemistry family, primarily the E1-E3 formulation/state comparisons, with E1 +P treated as a separate chemical perturbation. The intended experiment would use a direct 80-130 C sweep, so it does not rely on transferring the shared thermal shape into a new modifier chemistry; it is not assumed to remain inside the audited regularity support when acrylic-like, tackifier-like, AC1920, TK100, or other chemistry-changing modifiers are introduced.
planner.failure_mode: The realized processing-viscosity level is poorly reproducible and may fall outside the 120-130 C processing window.
planner.failure_mode_evidence: E2 shows large nominal repeat spread at matched temperatures: sample CV is 0.464-0.585 and the max/min ratio is 2.80-3.57 across 80-130 C.
planner.least_resolved_justification: The temperature response is measured across 80-130 C for multiple original formulations, with monotonic decreases and descriptive fit R2 values of approximately 0.965-0.998. In contrast, the realized level has very large E2 run-to-run spread at every measured temperature, with CV values near 46-58% and max/min ratios near 2.8-3.6; no candidate-specific level has been directly measured.
measurement_requirements: Measure the candidate directly by an 80-130 C temperature sweep in 10 C increments on a freshly prepared sample rather than reconstructing the processing-window level from a one-point anchor.
Use at least three independently prepared repeats or an equivalent state-control plan to quantify the large realization spread observed for E2.
Report the realized viscosity level at 120 and 130 C and compare it at matched temperature with the corresponding unmodified reactive-core reference.
Report the apparent temperature-response descriptor from ln(viscosity) versus 1/T and retain all measured values within the 80-130 C support.
Preserve the formulation and process history so that any level difference can be separated from realization-state variation.
planner.scientific_question: At matched temperature and relative to the corresponding unmodified reactive-core reference, does the candidate's realized viscosity level follow inert dilution, rise above it through acrylic-like association, or fall below it through plasticizing-continuum behavior, thereby separating H-LEVEL-DILUTE, H-LEVEL-ASSOC, and H-LEVEL-PLASTIC?

proposer.chemistry_support_assessment: The candidate is resin-modified AC1920/TK100 chemistry, outside the locally measured unmodified PPG2000/PDP70/MDI family. Therefore no shared thermal-shape transfer is assumed for the primary level result. The direct 80-130 C sweep is admissible because it measures the processing-window level and verifies the thermal response in this new chemistry; E_eta remains a fitted rheological descriptor rather than a directly model-free quantity.

outcome_interpretation.if_acceptance_criterion_met: The measured 120-130 C level change falls within 3.40% of exactly one registered prediction: -51.29% for H-LEVEL-DILUTE, 28.71% for H-LEVEL-ASSOC, or -88.79% for H-LEVEL-PLASTIC. That hypothesis is accepted for this composition, and the directly measured processing-window viscosity level is reported.
outcome_interpretation.if_falsification_criterion_met: H-LEVEL-ASSOC is falsified if the measured change is at or below -51.29%; H-LEVEL-PLASTIC is falsified if it is at or above -51.29%; H-LEVEL-DILUTE is falsified if the measured change differs from -51.29% by more than 3.40%.
outcome_interpretation.if_intermediate: A result outside all three 3.40% prediction bands does not select a registered level hypothesis; it indicates that the candidate exhibits an unregistered modifier-specific level response or that realization-state variation exceeds the plan's discrimination resolution. The processing-window level is still directly established, but the three-way attribution remains unresolved.

proposer.primary_observable: Directly measured realized viscosity level across 80-130 C, including the matched 120-130 C level change relative to the unmodified reactive-core reference; the sweep also provides the apparent temperature-response descriptor E_eta from ln(eta) versus 1/T.

ranked_alternatives.why_lower_value: It is genuinely tied in VOI, but its 15% acrylic level relies partly on provisional noncommensurate evidence and is less directly anchored than the approximately 20% acrylic region.
It is genuinely tied in VOI, but 17.5% is less directly represented by the external acrylic anchors than the selected 20% level.
It is genuinely tied in VOI, but the 22.5% acrylic intervention is a larger departure from the central, repeatedly documented approximately 20% region.
It is genuinely tied in VOI, but the 25% acrylic intervention is the largest perturbation in the tied set and is less minimal than the selected central supported point.
Its VOI is lower because the 7.5% tackifier loading lies outside the repeated 4.8-6.4% cluster, introducing extrapolation risk while offering no additional registered-hypothesis separation.

proposer.reasoning: S1C51 directly measures the decision quantity in the chemistry-shifted candidate instead of reconstructing it from an unaudited shared shape. It separates all three registered level hypotheses at the 3.40% sweep resolution, uses a dual-axis composition supported by external evidence, and selects the strongest central acrylic/tackifier intervention among a real five-card VOI tie.
proposer.tie_break_justification: All five cards have identical VOI component vectors, so the deterministic layer is genuinely indifferent. S1C51 is selected because its 20% acrylic-like loading is centered on the repeatedly documented, directly commensurate approximately 19-20% external acrylic-resin region, while its 5% TK100 loading lies in the repeatedly documented minor-tackifier cluster. It tests both independently supported axes without using the larger 25% intervention or the less directly commensurate 15% acrylic point.

robustness_adjudication.change_from_proposal: Retain the proposed experiment and candidate, but amend the M-SWEEP protocol to use at least three independently prepared repeats with matched unmodified reactive-core references and uncertainty-based interpretation. Do not treat the fitted E_eta descriptor or the aggregate level result as evidence of transferred shared-shape regularity, molecular association, or plasticization mechanism.
residual_decision_risk: Large realization-state variation may still obscure formulation-level differences even after replication.
The dual-axis AC1920/TK100 intervention cannot identify the independent contribution of either modifier axis.
A fitted E_eta descriptor in resin-modified chemistry remains conditional on regression and chemistry-domain support.
External analogue evidence supports the candidate region but does not establish the local optimum or outcome.
The direct sweep establishes processing-window viscosity for the tested realization but does not by itself resolve thermal-hold drift.
robustness_adjudication.skeptic_objection_reasoning: The strongest objection is that the specified single-repeat M-SWEEP cannot support a 3.40% hypothesis-separation or falsification criterion given the observed E2 realization spread of 46-58% CV. It does not change which experiment should be run: a direct 80-130 C M-SWEEP remains the appropriate admissible measurement for the processing-window level in this chemistry. However, it requires at least three independently prepared samples, preferably with matched independently prepared unmodified references, and the result must be interpreted as a direct level measurement with uncertainty. The three registered level hypotheses should not be accepted or falsified at the 3.40% threshold without an uncertainty estimate. The dual-axis composition also supports only an aggregate AC1920/TK100 response, not axis-specific or molecular-mechanism attribution.
robustness_adjudication.weight_sensitivity_assessment: S1C51::M-SWEEP is in the tied deterministic top set. No tested perturbation changes the tied top set: every weight term survives scaling from 0.5 to 1.5, with no recommendation_flip_boundary observed. These weightings are defensible as a sensitivity sweep of the transparent VOI score, but the resulting decision stability is not model confidence or evidence that the experiment is scientifically correct.

skeptic.chemistry_domain_support_assessment: The primary 120-130 C viscosity level stays inside measured chemistry support because M-SWEEP directly measures 80-130 C in the resin-modified AC1920/TK100 composition, and the binding applicability gate correctly allows this direct sweep while removing M-ANCHOR cards for unvalidated modified chemistry. The old shared thermal-response shape is not valid evidence for this modified chemistry until the direct sweep verifies it; E_eta from the sweep is still a fitted descriptor and requires replication for a robust chemistry-domain comparison.
skeptic.falsification_criterion_assessment: The protocol can generate a numerical level change, and that quantity is directly observed at 120 and 130 C. It cannot credibly meet the declared 3.40% falsification resolution because M-SWEEP specifies min_repeats: 1, does not estimate between-preparation variation, and the supplied E2 data show 46-58% coefficient of variation at matched temperatures. A result outside a 3.40% prediction band is therefore not distinguishable from realization-state noise.
leakage_findings: No result-derived candidate or outcome leakage is evident; the payload states that validation identity and outcome were unavailable and tie-breaking used pre-result external evidence.
The phrase 'acrylic-like association' or 'plasticizing-continuum behavior' exceeds what the planned rheological measurement can establish if interpreted as a molecular mechanism.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: A measured level near any registered prediction cannot support acceptance of exactly one hypothesis; apparent separation may be realization-state variation rather than formulation behavior.
objections.objection: The proposal claims that S1C51::M-SWEEP separates H-LEVEL-DILUTE, H-LEVEL-ASSOC, and H-LEVEL-PLASTIC at a 3.40% threshold, but the protocol has min_repeats: 1 while the audited E2 matched-temperature realization spread is CV 0.464-0.585 and max/min 2.80-3.57. The declared 3.40% discrimination resolution is therefore much smaller than the observed candidate-level state variation and is not demonstrated for this candidate.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: The experiment can at most test the aggregate level response of the AC1920/TK100 combination against the registered prediction bands; axis-specific or mechanistic attribution remains unsupported.
objections.objection: S1C51 changes both modifier axes simultaneously: AC1920 is 20.0% and TK100 is 5.0%, while the reactive mass fraction is reduced to 0.75. The experiment therefore changes dilution, acrylic-like loading, and minor-tackifier-like loading at once. A result above or below the dilution prediction cannot attribute the effect specifically to acrylic association versus TK100 behavior, nor can it establish that either axis independently causes the deviation.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: Direct processing-window viscosity can be reported, but the precision of the matched-reference level change and any conclusion about a changed thermal response will be overstated.
objections.objection: The viscosity level at 120 and 130 C is directly measured by M-SWEEP, which is a strength. However, the reported E_eta component is obtained by regressing ln(eta) against 1/T, and the proposal's interpretation also compares a candidate level with an unmodified reactive-core reference whose realization variation is large. Thus the level itself is direct, but the relative formulation effect and E_eta descriptor inherit reference-state and regression assumptions.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: The directly measured processing-window level remains interpretable, but claims that AC1920/TK100 preserves or changes the audited thermal-response regularity are not established with the specified replication.
objections.objection: The primary 120-130 C level remains inside measurement support because M-SWEEP directly measures 80-130 C for the resin-modified AC1920/TK100 chemistry; the binding audit correctly permits M-SWEEP and rejects one-point M-ANCHOR for this family. However, the prior shared thermal-response regularity was measured in unmodified PPG2000/PDP70/MDI, and the proposal reports E_eta from a fitted ln(eta) versus 1/T descriptor in the new chemistry after only one sweep repeat. The proposal does not reuse the old shared shape for the primary level, but it does not establish robust transferability of the thermal-response descriptor.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: Failure to fall inside a 3.40% prediction band would not falsify the hypothesis; it could simply reflect uncontrolled realization-state variation.
objections.objection: The falsification criterion for H-LEVEL-DILUTE is departure from -51.29% by more than 3.40%, while H-LEVEL-ASSOC and H-LEVEL-PLASTIC are separated at the same 3.40% boundary. The specified M-SWEEP requires only one freshly prepared sample and has no repeat-based uncertainty estimate, despite the audited E2 realization spread of 46-58% CV. The protocol therefore cannot reliably produce a result whose uncertainty is below the stated criterion.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: A rheological level result could be incorrectly presented as evidence for a molecular mechanism rather than as discrimination among phenomenological formulation-level predictions.
objections.objection: The payload does not show outcome leakage: the candidate and tie-break use pre-result external analogue evidence, and the validation identity and outcome are explicitly unavailable. However, the scientific-question wording attributes a level increase to 'acrylic-like association' and a decrease to 'plasticizing-continuum behavior.' Rheology measures the realized viscosity response and cannot establish molecular association or plasticization mechanisms; the registry's claim boundary explicitly limits these to formulation-level hypotheses.

skeptic.recommended_change: Retain the direct 80-130 C M-SWEEP but require at least three independently prepared S1C51 samples, preferably with matched independently prepared unmodified reactive-core references, and define the prediction-band decision using the resulting uncertainty before testing. If axis-specific attribution is required, replace the dual-axis composition with a factorial or single-axis comparison; otherwise restrict the claim to the aggregate AC1920/TK100 response.
skeptic.strongest_objection: The 3.40% falsification and hypothesis-separation criterion is not attainable with S1C51::M-SWEEP as specified: it requires only one repeat even though the audited E2 realization spread is CV 0.464-0.585 and max/min 2.80-3.57. The experiment may directly measure viscosity, but it cannot distinguish a 3.40% prediction difference from the known process-state variation.

tool_trace.name: get_chemistry_audited_rheology_summary
tool_trace.reason: The audited upstream material structure and local rheology evidence must be loaded before candidate or experiment ranking is admissible, and before any shared-shape or chemistry-support claim is used.

claim_boundaries: The shared-shape/state-shift structure is established only within the measured local chemistry family.
The apparent E_eta descriptor is rheological, not a chemical reaction activation energy.
The E1/E5 hold contrast does not identify a unique molecular mechanism.
The verified E1 +P phosphoric-acid perturbation is excluded from the primary same-composition fit and is interpreted separately as a chemical-perturbation check.
No validation-formulation identity or outcome is used by this tool.
design_rules: Represent a candidate as formulation plus process/realization state, not composition alone.

Use one state-specific anchor measurement to locate a new realization or nearby local formulation on the transferable thermal-response shape when it remains inside the supported local chemistry family.
Treat static viscosity, temperature response and thermal-hold stability as separate decision variables.
When the failure mode is hot-hold drift, choose an experiment and measurement window that directly test drift rather than only matching one nominal viscosity value.
Use external resin/tackifier evidence to define chemically plausible directions, but do not convert analogue proximity into a predicted local outcome.
Keep deliberately chemistry-perturbed curves outside same-composition fitting, but use them to test whether an intervention shifts viscosity scale, thermal-response shape, or both.

chemical_perturbation_check.interpretation: The verified low-dose H3PO4 perturbation shifts the observed viscosity level while remaining closely compatible with the local shared thermal-response geometry. It is a separate chemical-perturbation check and is not pooled into the primary same-composition state model.

observational_E1_GJJ_day1_comparator.interpretation_boundary: Observational reference only; the compact record does not establish a paired parent-batch relationship between E1 +P and E1 GJJ day-1.

one_point_state_calibration.interpretation: Within the tested local chemistry family, one state-specific viscosity anchor can locate a previously held-out nominal formulation on the shared thermal-response shape to roughly 6-10% pooled multiplicative error.
one_point_state_calibration.validation_scheme: leave one nominal formulation out; fit shared shape on the remaining formulations; use one anchor from the held formulation

state_shift_master_curve.interpretation: Within the chemistry-audited local family, a realization-specific viscosity-scale intercept plus a shared quadratic inverse-temperature response closes the data far better than a formulation-level intercept using the same thermal basis.

temporal_stability_coordinate.interpretation: Original E1 and E5 hold trajectories show that thermal-hold viscosity drift is strongly formulation dependent and should be treated separately from static viscosity.

thermal_coordinate.interpretation: The apparent temperature-sensitivity descriptor remains comparatively concentrated after chemistry auditing; it is a rheological descriptor, not a molecular reaction activation energy.

experiment_design_implications.hold_window: For the current local study, 120 C and the common 15-60 min window directly interrogate the observed instability while matching the available validation window.
experiment_design_implications.selection_target: Select a formulation-process point that is informative about the observed instability and state uncertainty, not merely the closest static-viscosity value.
experiment_design_implications.state_anchor: A single in-range anchor can be used for efficient local curve calibration; 120 C is operationally attractive because it is also the hold-stability test temperature.
experiment_design_implications.verified_acid_perturbation: E1 +P received 0.025 mmol H3PO4 from a 0.1 mol/L standard solution during dehydration. Its close agreement with the primary shared thermal shape makes it useful as a defined scale-versus-shape perturbation check, not as another nominal E1 realization.

provenance_audit.reason: E1 +P is a verified chemical perturbation: 0.025 mmol H3PO4 from a 0.1 mol/L standard solution was added during dehydration. It is excluded from the same-composition primary state model and exposed separately as a perturbation check.

result.source_scope: original pre-validation local measurements with chemistry-comparability audit

tool_trace.name: get_candidate_hypothesis
tool_trace.reason: This provides the evidence-derived candidate-space axes, reactive-core anchor, and historical boundary needed to judge which candidate experiments can separate the registered level hypotheses.

evidence: PAT_US20160215185A1: repeated acrylic tackifying resin examples at approximately 19-20% of total formulation
PAT_US6465104B1 Example 10: 25 wt% low-OH acrylic copolymer with direct 121 C viscosity-stability data
PAPER_CN_ADHESIVES_2025_34_09_54: reports a 15% preferred acrylic-resin addition level, retained as directional lower-bound evidence until its fraction denominator is reverified
acrylic_like_modifier_pct_total.interpretation: 20 and 25% are directly commensurate coarse anchors in the current curated record. The 15% grid level is retained as a lower-bound design point, but the literature denominator for the reported 15% addition level is not treated as an exact total-formulation anchor until reverified.

evidence: PAT_US5932680A: examples around 4.8-6.4% tackifying/hydrocarbon resin and preferred resin range 3-10 wt%
PAT_US20070155859A1: tackifiers/rheology-control agents typically used below about 10 wt%
minor_tackifier_like_modifier_pct_total.interpretation: 5% represents the repeatedly documented minor-resin region and 10% is a conservative coarse upper level.

result.claim_boundary: External examples are analogues. They support candidate-family and coarse-region hypotheses, not an exact optimum for AC1920/TK100 and not a proven local molecular mechanism. The current reconstruction uses only pre-result evidence at runtime; the exact validation coordinates and outcome are excluded from candidate construction, ranking and tie-breaking.

decision_policy.claim_boundary: This policy can recover an evidence-supported formulation neighborhood, but it is not a predictor of the exact wet-lab optimum.

acrylic_like.basis: 15% directional lower-region evidence plus directly commensurate ~19-20% examples; 25% remains directly supported but is a larger perturbation.

minor_tackifier_like.basis: Curated PUR examples repeatedly place tackifying/hydrocarbon resin near 5%, with broader guidance below about 10%.

experiment_intents.causal_isolation: Use when the primary objective is attribution of one formulation axis. Prefer a single active modifier axis only in this mode.
experiment_intents.performance_mitigation: Use when a measured failure mode is already established and the next experiment is intended to reduce that failure. Independently supported multi-modifier interventions are admissible.
experiment_intents.uncertainty_resolution: Use when missing process, stoichiometric or evidence information prevents an interpretable performance test.

decision_policy.purpose: Select an experimentally informative intervention from pre-result evidence without treating a literature composition as the hidden optimum.
ranking_rules: Exact distance to an external analogue anchor is audit metadata, not a primary optimization objective.
Candidates in the same evidence-support class are not rewarded merely for being numerically closer to a literature percentage.
For performance mitigation, two modifier axes may be combined when each is independently supported and the combination stays inside bounded evidence regions.

Among candidates with comparable evidence coverage and interpretability, prefer the smallest sufficient total modifier burden and the smallest justified departure from the characterized local chemistry.
A single-variable design is preferred only when causal attribution is the stated experiment intent; it is not a universal default.
Held-out validation coordinates and outcomes must never enter candidate construction, ranking or tie-breaking.

historical_status.interpretation: The prospective historical claim attaches to the Agent recommendation itself. The current coarse grid and fine-refinement software are later reproducible operationalizations of the evidence-constrained region and are not represented as the original contemporaneous freeze algorithm unless older provenance is recovered.

local_reactive_core_anchor.reason: E2 is the geometric centre of the original five-point local design: 50/50 PPG2000/PDP-70 and NCO:OH=1.80, centered between E1/E3 stoichiometric perturbations and E4/E5 composition perturbations.
local_reactive_core_anchor.stoichiometry_note: The E2 NCO:OH=1.80 label applies to the original reactive core. If a modifier contributes reactive OH or another NCO-reactive group, true stoichiometry must be recalculated from verified material specifications.

stability_hypotheses.H1_formulation_family: Partial replacement of the reactive-only formulation by an acrylic-like and/or minor tackifier-like resin can reduce hot-hold viscosity drift under matched process conditions.
stability_hypotheses.H2_functionality: At comparable acrylic loading, lower effective reactive-group density or lower-OH acrylic chemistry is expected to be more favorable for hot-hold viscosity stability than more highly reactive acrylic chemistry.
stability_hypotheses.H3_region: A useful candidate region is expected within the externally supported coarse space spanned by 15-25% acrylic-like modifier and 0-10% minor tackifier-like modifier, while preserving the relative E2 reactive-core proportions.

result.limitation: Patent comparison; acrylic materials are not AC1920 and the result is not a direct local-system measurement.

result.agent_hint: The no-acrylic/no-functional-tackifier comparator reported a larger stability value than several modifier-containing examples, providing directional support for a modifier-family hypothesis rather than proof of one optimum.

result.agent_hint: Published formulation art explicitly treats viscosity rise during prolonged hot holding as a design failure mode and cites a preferred stability level of no more than about 25% increase over 4-10 h; this supports thermal-hold stability as an independent design objective.

result.pattern: thermally stable reactive hot melt urethane composition

chemistry_applicability_audit.enforcement_note: In this condition the chemistry applicability audit is BINDING. The cards it marks inadmissible were removed before ranking and are not selectable. You may state that you disagree with the rule and why; naming a removed card is an invalid output.
rule_text: Scope: measurement admissibility, not formulation admissibility.
M-HOLD-120, M-REPEAT and M-SWEEP observe their quantity directly and remain admissible.

M-ANCHOR is admissible only when assess_shared_shape_applicability returns shared_shape_use == 'allowed_with_state_anchor', or when a versioned prior direct sweep has verified transferability for the same chemistry family.
Otherwise M-ANCHOR is inadmissible_before_shape_verification: the one-point anchor would reconstruct 120-130 C viscosity through a shape that has never been measured for that chemistry.
This audit is a deterministic scientific rule, not a VOI penalty and not a model opinion. Whether it is binding in this run is stated by the enforcement field.

voi.formula: VOI = w_hyp * hypothesis_discrimination + w_unc * uncertainty_reduction + w_dec * decision_relevance + w_int * measurement_interpretability - w_ext * extrapolation_risk - w_proc * process_state_risk. Every component is normalized to [0, 1] by construction. This is a transparent normalized score with reported weight sensitivity, not a Bayesian posterior.
voi.tie_note: These experiments share an identical component vector. The deterministic tool is indifferent among them. Any choice within this set must be justified scientifically.
